name: Kimi to Issho ni Dekiru Koto Young Widow -Yume-
original_name: キミといっしょにデキること young widow -yume-
source:
Morino Yua was at school together, only a year older than me. I had a crush on her at first sight, because she was incredibly cute...... she got married with a teacher Setouchi as soon as she graduated from school. But it did not last even a year, I heard that she became a widow after he was killed in a car accident..... Few years later, I came across Yua by accident. She looked just as I remembered.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE024363.html]DLsite English[/url]]
